patch_description: Replace the final single-worst-triangle coordinate polish with a deterministic active-set refinement. Heilbronn optima are governed by several nearly tied triangle constraints, so moving only points of one arbitrarily selected minimum triangle often stalls immediately. The new polish considers all near-active triples, generates axial, simplex-diagonal, partner-centroid, and boundary-tangent directions, and performs a short deterministic line search at several displacement lengths. This is particularly useful near simplex boundaries, where projection changes the effective direction of a move. Candidates are still accepted only on a strict improvement of the true minimum area, preserving the primary objective exactly.
